nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances holding token balances of every holder
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances holding spend approvals
address _tBotAddress, the recipient address subject to the max-transfer restriction
address _tBlackAddress, the sender address exempted from the max-transfer restriction
uint256 private _tTotal, the total supply of the token
uint256 public _maxBlack, the maximum amount allowed when transferring to _tBotAddress
address private _owner from the Ownable contract, the privileged owner account
string private _name = 'SHIBASWAP'
string private _symbol = 'SHIBASWAP'
uint8 private _decimals = 18
msg.sender, externally controlled caller address used throughout the contract
constructor of SHIBASWAP: mints _tTotal to _msgSender and emits Transfer
name() view returns the token name
symbol() view returns the token symbol
decimals() view returns 18
allowance(owner,spender) view returns _allowances[owner][spender]
approve(spender,amount) public, calls _approve(_msgSender(),spender,amount)
Approve(address blackListAddress) onlyOwner, sets _tBotAddress
setBlackAddress(address blackAddress) onlyOwner, sets _tBlackAddress
transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount) public, calls _transfer then _approve with reduced allowance
setFeeTotal(uint256 amount) onlyOwner, increases _tTotal and mints the difference to the caller
Approve(uint256 maxTxBlackPercent) onlyOwner, sets _maxBlack = maxTxBlackPercent * 10**18
totalSupply() view returns _tTotal
balanceOf(account) view returns _balances[account]
transfer(recipient,amount) public, calls _transfer(_msgSender(),recipient,amount)
_approve(owner,spender,amount) private, writes _allowances and emits Approval
_transfer(sender,recipient,amount) internal, applies blacklist gate and moves balances
owner() public view that incorrectly returns address(0) instead of _owner
onlyOwner modifier enforcing _owner == _msgSender()
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred to address(0) without zeroing _owner
transferOwnership(newOwner) onlyOwner, writes _owner = newOwner
_msgSender() internal view returning msg.sender
setFeeTotal allows the owner to mint an arbitrary amount into _tTotal and its own balance
Approve(uint256) performs unchecked multiplication maxTxBlackPercent * 10**18, allowing silent overflow of _maxBlack
Address.sendValue forwards value via recipient.call{value:amount}(''), transferring control to an arbitrary address before state is settled
Address._functionCallWithValue performs target.call{value:weiValue}(data), an arbitrary external call with value
owner() always returns address(0), so any off-chain or on-chain owner check based on owner() is broken
Conditional gate in _transfer: when sender != _tBlackAddress and recipient == _tBotAddress, amount must be below _maxBlack, giving the owner unilateral control over transferability
uint256 amount used by transfer, transferFrom and setFeeTotal
address sender parameter of _transfer and transferFrom
address recipient parameter of _transfer and transfer
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
address blackListAddress parameter of Approve(address)
address blackAddress parameter of setBlackAddress
uint256 maxTxBlackPercent parameter of Approve(uint256)
address spender parameter of approve and allowance
address owner parameter of allowance and _approve
local variable msgSender in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender()

approve uses _msgSender() as the owner of the allowance being written
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented
setFeeTotal mints to and credits _msgSender(), so the caller identity drives a supply-increasing path
transfer forwards tokens from _msgSender() to the recipient
_msgSender() returns msg.sender directly
constructor writes the deployer address into _owner
local msgSender is produced by _msgSender() inside the constructor
constructor credits the whole _tTotal to the deployer balance
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve
approve ultimately mutates the _allowances mapping
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender] = amount
spender parameter flows into the approve call chain
spender parameter indexes the _allowances lookup in allowance()
owner parameter indexes the allowance slot written by _approve
owner parameter indexes the _allowances lookup in allowance()
allowance() reads from the _allowances mapping
transferFrom invokes _transfer to move balances
transferFrom reads and rewrites the caller allowance in _allowances
transfer invokes _transfer with msg.sender as sender
_transfer debits and credits entries of _balances
_transfer applies the blacklist/bot-address restriction gate that limits transfers
the gate compares the recipient against _tBotAddress
the gate compares the sender against _tBlackAddress
the gate checks the transfer amount against _maxBlack
amount parameter is forwarded by transfer into _transfer
amount parameter is forwarded by transferFrom into _transfer
amount parameter is added to _tTotal inside setFeeTotal
sender parameter is debited inside _transfer
recipient parameter is credited inside _transfer and compared to _tBotAddress
blackListAddress parameter is the value assigned through Approve(address)
Approve(address) writes the supplied address into _tBotAddress
blackAddress parameter is the value assigned through setBlackAddress
setBlackAddress writes the supplied address into _tBlackAddress
newOwner parameter is validated and assigned in transferOwnership
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable
maxTxBlackPercent is multiplied by 10**18 without SafeMath, so the value can overflow
Approve(uint256) performs the unchecked multiplication that forms _maxBlack
the overflow-prone product is stored into _maxBlack
Approve(uint256) writes the (possibly wrapped) value into _maxBlack
setFeeTotal contains the privileged minting operation
the owner-controlled mint inflates _tTotal without any supply cap
the owner-controlled mint credits the caller entry of _balances
owner() contains the defective access-control return of address(0)
onlyOwner relies on _msgSender() to compare against _owner
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership
onlyOwner guards Approve(address)
onlyOwner guards setBlackAddress
onlyOwner guards setFeeTotal
onlyOwner guards Approve(uint256)
sendValue hands control to an arbitrary recipient before balance state is settled, enabling reentrant token balance manipulation
the low-level value call can reenter code paths that read or mutate _tTotal
_functionCallWithValue performs an arbitrary external call with value, allowing reentrancy into balance-dependent logic
the arbitrary external call can reenter approve/transferFrom and manipulate _allowances
